capabilities: publish a vault folder to a GitHub Pages repository
render markdown pages with a sidebar, file explorer and keyword search
display tables of contents, callouts, math and footnotes in pages
add Utterances-based comments to published pages
generate indexable SEO output and a configurable homepage
disambiguation: Publishes an entire selected folder as a blog site; not a single-note sharing or export tool.
extras: Beta with limited features; tested only on Mac and may not work on Windows; requires a public <username>.github.io repository; no custom domain or private repository support; block and heading references are unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes as a public blog site directly from a vault folder to GitHub Pages.

relations.evidence: publish your vault or directory to GitHub Pages Blog
Comments layout provided by the Utterances are supported

requires.name: GitHub repository with Pages and Actions

summary: Publishes a selected vault folder as a static blog on GitHub Pages with an Obsidian-style layout and Markdown rendering.
